===Rewards===
*[[Ardougne cloak 1]]:
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Ardougne Monastery]]
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 30
*Earn twice as many [[death rune]]s from trading in [[Cat|cats]] to [[Civilian|civilians]] in [[West Ardougne]]
*Drops from [[Jubster]]s and [[Frogeel]]s will be [[noted]] in the [[Creature Creation]] activity
